notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market analytics SaaS building conversational support + embedded search in product. Currently heavy OpenAI dependency (chat completions + embeddings). Evaluating Redwood as drop-in hosted replacement with path to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

Recent timeline / activity:
- 2024-09-12: initial intro call (AE Aisha). high-level use cases + cost pain (40% of infra/OPEX tied to embeddings).
- 2024-10-03: technical deep-dive (SE Carlos) — discussed OpenAI compatibility layer and SDK parity. Fireflies: ff_2024-10-03_8472.
- 2024-10-10: POC scoping doc shared (drive:/pocs/mosaicharbor/poc-plan-v1.docx). agreed 2-week hosted POC, sample traffic + production-like prompt set.
- 2024-10-24: hosted POC kicked off (team integrated Redwood client via OpenAI-compat wrapper).
- 2024-11-05: interim findings — embeddings latency ~25% lower on Redwood-hosted variant; summarization parity mostly OK but spotted a ~2-3% regression in entity extraction task vs OpenAI baseline. raised INF-2345.
- 2024-11-18: security review checklist submitted; asked for SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML flow, and data residency confirmation (drive:/security/mosaicharbor-security-faq.pdf). SEC-7812 tracking KMS/residency question.

Use-case & requirements (customer quotes / shorthand):
- "We need a drop-in replacement for OpenAI — minimal code churn, prompt parity, same streaming semantics." — Head of Platform.
- Workloads: chat-based user support (conversational retrieval), product-doc search (embeddings + rerank), automated summarization for release notes, internal code-assist for engineers.
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms for embeddings lookup (regional), p95 < 350ms for short chat responses (90% of traffic).
- Throughput: baseline 400-600 reqs/min during peak; expect 2x growth over 12 months.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. target ~30% reduction in per-token/embedding cost when moving to Dedicated.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: prompt-parity <= 1% quality regression on benchmark set, embeddings cosine similarity delta < 0.02, stable streaming + function-calling behavior, reproducible model pinning.

Technical notes & migration concerns:
- Main blocker: tokenization and subtle prompt-response differences; some prompts that relied on OpenAI-specific quirks produce slightly different completions.
- Looking for OpenAI-compat layer in Redwood SDK; must support choice of model variants and transparent token accounting.
- Want per-route routing policy: hosted for dev, dedicated for prod; automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.
- Requesting eval harness: side-by-side A/B (OpenAI vs Redwood) using existing unit tests and 1k prompt parity set.
- Security: require SSO/SAML integration, audit logs, KMS for keys at rest, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Pricing conversation: request tiered committed commit model for Dedicated (monthly) with ability to burst on hosted. drive:/pricing/dedicated-proposal-draft.xlsx shared.
- Forecast: procurement in Q4 discussions, likely decision window Jan 2025. target ARR 50k-250k if Dedicated commit accepted.

Next steps (short):
- Finish 2-week hosted POC, collect parity metrics and regression examples (owner: Carlos). deadline: 2024-12-06.
- Run evaluation report + demo for execs week of 2024-12-09. include cost delta scenarios.
- Prepare Dedicated sizing and pricing for 3-month commit + canary rollout plan.

Open items / blockers:
- Prompt parity regressions (need engineering triage with Redwood inference team).
- Clarify EU data residency path for Dedicated (legal + infra).
- Exec sign-off on pricing — internal procurement cycle may take until Feb.
